entities.name: Arayik Mirzoyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Arayik Mirzoyan is an Armenian weightlifter. He won a silver medal at the 2011 European Weightlifting Championships. Both Mirzoyan and the gold medalist totaled 347 kg, but Mirzoyan took silver due to personal weight difference.
